scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build:mac && open -n "../LPFAP/mac/mac-arm64/Lassi Shop POS.app"
scripts.desktop:win: npm run dist && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const cp=require('child_process'); const base='release'; const candidates=[]; const walk=(dir)=>{for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})) { const full=path.join(dir,entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) { walk(full); } else if (entry.name.toLowerCase() === 'lassi shop pos.exe') { candidates.push(full); }}}; if (fs.existsSync(base)) walk(base); const exe=candidates.find((p)=>fs.existsSync(p)); if (!exe) { const portable=path.join(base,'Lassi Shop POS.exe'); if (fs.existsSync(portable)) { console.log('Launching:', portable); cp.spawn(portable,{stdio:'inherit',shell:false}); process.exit(0); } console.error('Windows executable not found in release/.'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Launching:', exe); cp.spawn(exe,{stdio:'inherit',shell:false});"
